messages:
maria: FYI planning a rolling reboot + driver micro-patch in us-east1 on Thu 01:30-05:30 UTC. Cohorts of 4 nodes (~32 GPUs) every 25m, AZ-scoped.

sam: Expected capacity impact?

maria: ~7% during drains; will throttle non-prod and batch jobs to avoid spilling.

anya: Any IO-sensitive tenants to flag?

maria: Yes, flagging tenants with large embedding batches; ops will notify support.

eng-oncall-bot: Maintenance scheduled: us-east1 driver patch, start=1732181400, end=1732195800. Canary racks: r5, r9.

ops: I'll publish status page banner and targeted emails to Dedicated accounts with >5% usage. Draft out Tue 18:00 UTC.

sam: Add a smoke gate after cohort-2: run kvcache-seed and generator latency check. Pause if p99 regresses >12%.

maria: Gate added. Rollback: stop drains, uncordon last drained nodes, revert routing weights. Runbook link in internal docs.

ops: Confirmed communications and billing note for estimated overflow cost (~1k-1.8k USD).

maria: Final checklist: confirm canaries, enable throttle rules, infra automation smoke gate, publish comms. We'll update if things change.
